notes: ProCompNav answers checked against the target photo (white distressed 3-drawer chest with a vase on top, under a colorful painting, at the foot of the staircase; c4 views show the same chest by the stairs): (1) white color = Yes: the chest is painted white. (2) beside seating = No: it stands alone in a stair nook, no chair, sofa or bench next to it. Truth table follows the log's pruning exactly ([c3,c4] then [c4]). Labeling notes: c1 is a pale blue-gray louvered nightstand, labeled NOT white (it reads clearly bluish next to the white doors/trim; this is the one judgement call that matters for the log path). c3's 'cabinet' is the white cubby storage under the mudroom bench, so it counts as next to seating (it is part of a bench). c2 is a navy bathroom vanity next to a toilet; the toilet is not counted as a chair/sofa/bench. c0 is a brown wood dresser with a lamp, next to a white desk and windows.
